# YepIts.ai

> YepIts.ai is an AI-powered YouTube video summarizer that turns long videos into concise, accurate summaries. Get the key points of any video in seconds — transcripts, key takeaways, and clickable timestamps. Free tier: 3 summaries per day for videos up to 15 minutes. Pro tier: $7/month for unlimited summaries with no video length cap.

## Product Pages

- [YepIts.ai Homepage](https://yepits.ai/) — Paste any YouTube URL and get an AI summary in seconds
- [Pricing](https://yepits.ai/#pricing) — Free (3/day, videos ≤15 min) and Pro ($7/mo, unlimited)
- [Sign Up](https://yepits.ai/) — Use the homepage; no account required for the free tier
